figurative_meaning_en: To manage or earn enough for daily living expenses
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরিবারের জন্য দিন চালানো খুব কঠিন হয়ে পড়েছে।
তিনি ছোটখাটো ব্যবসা করে দিন চালান।
example_sentences_in_english: It's become very difficult to make ends meet for the family.
He runs a small business to get by day to day.
note: The idiom reflects the everyday economic challenges in Bengali society, often implying modest or hand-to-mouth existence.
